name: TOTP Sign-In Succeeds
summary: An identified returning user submits a valid authenticator code and the server establishes a normal authenticated application session.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active durable identity with confirmed email and enrolled TOTP is prepared for sign-in

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Prepared test-user email resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

inputs.name: Verification Code
inputs.description: Current TOTP generated from the enrolled authenticator secret by deterministic test setup.

serverInteraction.intent: Resolve the existing durable identity, verify the submitted TOTP proof, establish the application session, and resolve the landing destination.

postconditions.expression: the durable identity remains active with TOTP enabled, records a successful login, and the resolved application landing destination is active

sourceReferences.note: AuthenticateWithTotpAsync is the stable browser application entry point and adapts successful proof into the normal application session.
Typed handler resolves the durable identity and delegates proof validation to the real MFA manager.
Real-path integration proof covers valid TOTP verification and session establishment without mocking the MFA manager.
React Native uses generated AuthClient.createTotpToken and the existing token-session lifecycle.
